##### Project general facts

G24 Warsan is a residential project developed by Rokane, featuring a variety of living spaces including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. The development emphasizes a modern design with ample natural light and a focus on creating a comfortable living environment. Residents benefit from a selection of amenities designed for an active lifestyle, including sports facilities and swimming pools, all conveniently situated within the complex.

Amenities offered at G24 Warsan encompass a fitness center, sports facilities, and swimming pools, designed to support a healthy and balanced lifestyle. The project also incorporates spacious common areas and meticulously maintained landscaping to foster a strong sense of community and well-being among residents. 

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. The kitchens are thoughtfully equipped with state-of-the-art appliances.

##### Location description and benefits

Strategically positioned for convenience, G24 Warsan enjoys a prime location with easy accessibility to key destinations across the city. Proximity to major thoroughfares and public transportation hubs ensures seamless connectivity to business districts, shopping centers, dining establishments, and other essential amenities, making everyday living hassle-free for its residents.

In essence, G24 Warsan emerges as the epitome of comfort, quality of life, and practicality, offering a holistic living experience that caters to the modern lifestyle aspirations of its residents.

Dubai International City, centrally located in Dubai, offers residents a host of advantages. Its strategic position within the city grants easy access to essential amenities and attractions, facilitated by its proximity to major transportation networks. This seamless connectivity not only simplifies commuting but also enhances the community's vibrancy and diversity, fostering a multicultural environment reflective of Dubai's global status. With a myriad of retail outlets, dining options, and recreational facilities nearby, Dubai International City provides residents with everything they need for a convenient and enriching lifestyle.
